title: A limit of 2 requests per second, seen by one client
caption: The third request in the same second is rejected cheaply; the next second starts a fresh allowance.

messages.label: request #1 (t = 0.1 s)
messages.note: First request of this second: the counter for this key goes 0 → 1.

messages.label: request #2 (t = 0.4 s)
messages.note: Counter 1 → 2: still within the limit of 2.

messages.label: request #3 (t = 0.7 s)
messages.note: Counter would go to 3 > 2: reject without touching the API.

messages.label: request #4 (t = 1.2 s)
messages.note: A new second (or refilled tokens): the request is allowed again.
